title: Released my first AI-assisted game on Steam last week. Here's how it's going so far.
author: CubeUnleashed
selftext:
​

Hey folks!

I released my little dark fantasy hidden-object game 100 Hidden Relics last week. It's made in Godot 4 and pretty much entirely vibecoded.

For the visuals, I generated assets with Midjourney, edited them in Photoshop, applied dithering and manually arranged everything into scenes using a modular building-block system. So while AI did a lot of the heavy lifting, the actual world-building and composition was done by hand. As were the cutscenes.

For marketing, I mostly tried Reddit, Instagram reels, reaching out to smaller newd outlets and sending keys to Steam curators.

One reel got around 10k views and I managed to collect roughly 1,000 wishlists before launch. Pretty modest numbers, but I'm happy with them. Most other posts barely got any attention lol.

There are a handful of Steam reviews so far, some positive, some negative. it's been a fun little experiment and I'm glad I got something released.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4962590/100\_Hidden\_Relics/
